items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: I think his name was Gilbert.

ctx.x: He just ran up there and killed him. You've heard about that, huh? Yeah, I heard he got killed, I didn't know. Yeah, yeah. Yeah, right over to Joyce Lewis.
I think his name was Gilbert.
He pushed Joyce Lewis in front of me. Should have pushed Father Al in front of me. You see the thing over there? You see, now a lot of stuff that you find out to do, you didn't know.
